name: Autograph Card
balance_transfer_fee: 3% of each transfer (minimum $5) within the first 120 days of account opening; up to 5% (minimum $5) after

welcome_bonus.requirement: after you spend $1,000 in purchases within the first 3 months of account opening

verdict.text: Keep for a genuinely wide 3x list, all with no annual fee

earn_rates.category: Travel: airfare, hotels, car rentals, cruises

earn_note: The 3x list is unusually broad for a no-fee card, covering six everyday categories at once with no spending cap. Points don't expire as long as the account stays open and in good standing.

redemption_options.method: Cash redemption (statement credit or account credit)
Pay with Rewards at PayPal checkout
Gift cards from 250+ merchants (e-gift cards from $10)
Book travel through the Wells Fargo Rewards portal
Transfer to select travel loyalty programs

points.note: Wells Fargo doesn't publish a bonused travel-portal rate for this program the way some competitors do, so cash and travel-portal redemptions both land close to 1 cent per point. Transfers to loyalty programs exist but Wells Fargo doesn't publish per-partner ratios on its marketing pages, so the effective value there varies by partner and isn't independently confirmed here.

transfer_partners.highlight: Wells Fargo Rewards points can transfer to select airline and hotel loyalty programs, but the current partner list and transfer ratios aren't published on the card's marketing pages; treat the transfer option as unverified until confirmed in the Wells Fargo Rewards portal at account level.

insurance.detail: Up to $600 per claim against damage or theft when you pay your monthly cell phone bill with this card, minus a $25 deductible, max 2 claims per 12 months
Secondary coverage only, applies after your personal auto insurance
Not responsible for unauthorized transactions once reported

protection_note: Cell phone protection is solid for a no-fee card. There's no trip cancellation, purchase protection, or extended warranty here; those show up starting at the Autograph Journey tier.
rental_note: Secondary coverage only, meaning it pays after your personal auto policy for whatever's left. Charge the full rental cost to the card and decline the counter's optional CDW to activate it.

services.name: 20,000-point welcome bonus
services.detail: 20,000 bonus points (about $200) after spending $1,000 in purchases within the first 3 months.

services.name: Visa Signature Concierge and Luxury Hotel Collection
services.detail: 24/7 concierge for reservations and event tickets, plus perks at select luxury hotel properties.

services.name: Roadside Dispatch
services.detail: 24/7 towing and roadside assistance, billed to the card at time of dispatch, no membership fee.

services.name: My Wells Fargo Deals
services.detail: Personalized merchant offers that earn extra cash back or points as an account credit.

additional_cards.title: Authorized users

benefits.text: Earns points on their spend (into your account)

additional_cards.note: No cost to add, and their spending earns the same category rates into your account.

timeline.text: Wells Fargo launches Autograph as a no-annual-fee points card with a wide 3x category list, its first real entry into the points-earning travel card space alongside Active Cash's cash back.
Wells Fargo drops the 'Signature' suffix and refreshes the card's benefits, aligning it with the newly launched Autograph Journey as a two-tier Autograph lineup.
